name: @levinthal/ladder
description: The catalytic-ladder contact-graph engine, vendored for Buhera OS from levinthal/enzymes/web. Computes an intensive derived power (beta = local floor / local separation cost) over a weighted contact graph, proves it invariant under graph extension, composes a sequence of such powers multiplicatively into a ladder that can legitimately refuse (subfloor) when declared rungs cannot reach a declared target, and provides a costed commitment machine (free probe/derive/observe, one commitment per climbed rung). Dependency-free pure JS, ported from shk_core.py. Public surface: ContactGraph, chainGraph, powerIntensive/powerGlobalFloor/powerExtensive, composeMultiplicative and siblings, Machine, deriveSequential, makeVerdict.
author: Kundai Farai Sachikonye <kundai.sachikonye@wzw.tum.de>
